title: AI model entries carry a tier key so the closed picker can show the bare tier name (「快速」)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Split from #35445 by seat 5 (area ux-1): item 5 asks that the closed model picker show only the tier name (e.g. 「快速」) instead of the truncated 「Fast · Claude Haiku…」. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens today (os-dev report 7014485394 on #35445)

- The model entry in `AiModelsResponseSchema` has no tier field, so the console only has cloud's composite label (tier · model name).
- Getting the tier by splitting that label at its first ` · ` would be a consumer-side parse, which contract-first forbids.
- PR #35573 keeps the label, truncated, and drops the multiplier from it.

## What to do

1. Add an optional tier key (a localizable label or a tier id) to the model entry in the spec.
2. Cloud fills it.
3. The closed picker shows it when present and falls back to today's label when absent.

Clause-② yes (spec contract addition), so a seat contract review applies. A cloud-side card follows once the key lands.

## Done when

With a tier-bearing entry, the closed picker reads the tier name only. Without one, it reads today's label. Both cases are pinned.
